Kharis Church

Beyond Crossover

Kharis Church is led by Head Pastor Rev. Dr. David Antwi. We are a friendly, caring and exciting family church that seeks to influence our society with the reality of God’s love and the reliability of His principles by ministering to the spiritual, physical, social and emotional needs of people who care to experience God in a dynamic and a living way.
